headline: Day 200 — and the newest of the five open gates is 17 days old. Monday came and went with no brief and no word on whether either tap fired; Jul 27–28 the pipeline itself went dark, which makes today's first job honest reporting and its second job the only three moves that need nobody's permission. Wednesday is a full business day on both sides — the first one a delivered brief has landed on since Jul 20 — so the IRS line is open, HR inboxes are open, Mercedes is reachable, and Batch 1 has been sitting postable for 17 days waiting on two founders and one click.

spotlight.title: Post Batch 1 — 17 days postable, third brief in a row naming it
spotlight.detail: 6–7 reels declared ready Jul 12. Both Pages (Hanflux AI · Oraya AI) have carried real Overview and positioning copy since Jul 19, so the "the page is blank so they go away" problem the whole plan was built around is already solved — the only thing missing is posts. This needs no IRS reply, no Fable, no compliance clearance, no spend and no third party: two founders mutually pick reels and hit post on personal + both company pages. Until it happens every PhantomBuster sequence stays dark — connect-requests to dealership GMs, follow-ups, page-invites, all of it — and PhantomBuster's free tier keeps burning calendar, not execution time. Hanflux is showing +430% search appearances on the name alone with nothing to land on. This is the third consecutive brief to name it the keystone; on Day 200 it is also the cheapest thing on the board.

spotlight.title: IRS EIN — 31 days silent, and today is a full business day
spotlight.detail: Re-faxed Jun 28; the "~8 business day" window closed Jul 11 and 14 days of live watch-list searches have returned nothing in either direction. Every brief since Jul 13 has pointed at a Monday 8 AM PT window; Monday Jul 27 passed with no brief published and no founder report, so we still do not know whether the call was ever placed. Wednesday reopens the same door: call the EIN line the moment it opens 8 AM PT (expect auto-disconnects — redial), and check RedFax 510-497-1224 for a reply that may have landed silently. Have the SS-4 details in hand before dialling so the call confirms rather than searches. One line back either way — "called, here's what they said" or "didn't get to it" — turns 31 days of guessing into a fact the next brief can build on.

spotlight.title: Full Disk Access toggle — it failed again at 09:02 IST this morning
spotlight.detail: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Full Disk Access → enable the launchd runner. The autoloop retried today and the error log took a fresh line at 09:02 IST: "oraya-loop.sh: Operation not permitted" — the same permission, the 31st consecutive day, frozen at cycle 10 since Jun 28. Two minutes flips it and the next 09:00 run executes cycle 11 unattended under guardrails.md with no further founder input, ever. Do it in the same sitting as the second half of this item: diagnose why the brief pipeline went dark Jul 27–28 (and Jul 21–23 before it). That's now two autonomous systems silent, and the reporting layer going quiet is worse than the loop going quiet — it's the one that would have told you.
